title.narrative: World Wide Documentaries - Not My Life 2012-2014
World Wide Documentaries - Not My Life 2012-2014

description.narrative: Global Awareness as to what human trafficking actually is; who it affects; and the underlying causes that contribute to its proliferation is radically altered.
Stöd till filmprojektet "Not My Life" som syftar till att skapa global uppmärksamhet kring problement med trafficking av barn.
Support to the film project " Not My Life" aiming at creating global awareness around the challenges of trafficking of children.

Based on the available information Sida has, it is assessed that Worldwide Documentaries and the Not My Life Awareness Initiative (NMLAI) has demonstrated good results. New partnerships have been formed but at the same time the organisation has been able to maintain and deepen already existing partnerships. The fact that WWD customised and adapted each screening to the local context and developed strategies for community engagement made the organisation well positioned to reach its objective. The NMLAI have had widespread reach of the documentary. Highschools and universities have been actively involved and have had either public screenings and events of the documentary or requested a copy of the film. The demand for the film has been high. The post screenings activities and the discussions after the screenings have been central in spreading the awareness to the target audience. Sida assesses that WWD succeeded to spread the awareness about the film.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
